name: Ellis Twilight
original_name: エリス・トワイライト
source:
A somewhat disturbing young man who belongs to Crown and also serves as Jude's assistant.

He is kind and gentle to everyone, but he is strangely obsessed with other people's "Happiest Moments in Life."

He has "love" that he wants to prove no matter what...

Organisation: Crown
Fairy Tale Curse: Sleeping Beauty's Thorn

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/villains/original/character/#ellis]official website[/url]]
